entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, my agent ID is 301. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac. I... I'm calling about my VeloBand GPS Tracker. I'm just so disappointed. I don't think it's working at all.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. Could I start with your name and order number, please?
Of course. My name is Sarah Chen. The order number is VF88-1209-4551.

Thank you, Sarah. I see your account here. It looks like you're one of our VIP members; we really appreciate your loyalty. The VeloBand was delivered 11 days ago, on January 3rd. To make sure I'm on the right page, could you tell me a little more? Is it a technical fault with the device, or is it just not meeting your expectations?
Oh, it's definitely a technical fault. It's just not working properly. I charged it fully, but it won't sync with the app. I've tried everything the little manual says. I feel like it must be broken.
I understand how frustrating that must be, especially when you're excited to start using a new device. You mentioned it won't sync. Does the screen light up at all?

Yes, the screen comes on, but that's it. It's basically a useless bracelet right now. I just think the one I received is defective. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years and I've never had a problem like this. I saved up for this band, and I... I was just hoping to get my money back.

I can certainly see why you feel that way, Sarah, and I want to make this right. For the new VeloBand Pulse, our standard return window for a preference change is 10 days. However, what you're describing sounds like a warranty issue, not a preference, and that's a completely different situation.
So... I can't return it? I really needed this money for some bills. I just feel so let down.

Please don't feel let down. We are absolutely going to solve this. Because it sounds like a defective unit, we need to get it fixed or replaced for you under its warranty. The best team for that is our technical support specialists. They have advanced diagnostic tools and can determine if it's a simple fix or if we need to send you a brand new one immediately. Would you be open to me transferring you to them?
I guess so. I just... I hate being a bother. It's all so complicated.

It's no bother at all, Sarah, it's my job to help. And for the inconvenience this has caused you, especially as a VIP member, I've gone ahead and added a $25 VeloFit store credit to your account. You can use that for any future purchase. Let me get you transferred to tech support right now, they'll take great care of you.
Oh! A credit? You didn't have to do that. That's... that's very kind of you, Isaac. Thank you. Yes, please, you can transfer me. I appreciate your help.
You are very welcome, Sarah. I'm glad I could help. Please hold one moment while I connect you. The next voice you hear will be one of our technical specialists.
